name: Indie App Sales
accepts: Apple indie apps (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS). A yearly sale event rather than a list; press roundups have picked indie deals from it.
cost_note: Listing cost not stated; sponsor slots are paid.
how_to_submit: Register as a developer and add your apps at https://indieappsales.com/devs before the event. Developer notes are kept at https://github.com/mattcorey/indie-dev-sales.
rules: The 2026 event runs from Black Friday to Cyber Monday (27 to 30 Nov 2026, per a 2 Nov 2026 reading). Signup closes before the sale starts; the cutoff could not be read.
The notes ask that discounts are configured in App Store Connect or whatever store front you use.
status_note: On 12 Nov 2026 only the page title rendered without JavaScript; dates, cutoff and form were not re-read.
